statement: Let D range over all loopless digraphs on seven labeled vertices, with at most one arc in each ordered direction and with antiparallel arcs allowed. If D contains no not-necessarily-induced copy of the regular five-vertex tournament Reg5, then sum_v d_D^+(v)^2 <= 186. Equality is attained, and it holds exactly for the 105 labeled copies of the balanced complete bidirected four-partite graph T_4(7), whose part sizes are 2,2,2,1. Equivalently, ex^+_{L2}(7,Reg5)=186 with this equality classification.
contribution: This is an exact computer-assisted theorem at the first order left unchecked by the preceding small-order work, together with a complete labeled equality-case census. A score-pruned enumeration of all 7,377,595 threshold candidates is paired with a separately structured degree-vector replay of all 6,937,603 strict candidates. The claim is strictly finite and does not settle the original conjecture for m>=8; the original problem remains unresolved.
